title: Huly mock UI
description: Ten small product-UI vignettes drawn from divs, lit by soft glows: command palette over a keyboard, day planner, schedule, notification bell in a halftone ring, checklist, event card, block menu, voice call, chat, project panel.
notes: made to fill a dark card (huly-card); it reads the dark colours of the surrounding .dark element
people are initials in gradient circles, no photos
